reconcile.note: Gill reads 'the twelve' in 1 Corinthians 15:5 as the apostles' retained title of office, not a literal headcount, noting some manuscripts read 'the eleven' instead.

sides.snippet: But the eleven disciples went into Galilee
sides.verseText: But the eleven disciples went into Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus had sent them.

sides.snippet: and that he appeared to Cephas, then to the twelve.
sides.verseText: and that he appeared to Cephas, then to the twelve.
